figure: Fig. S10 | A structure-based recommender gains most where molecules have been measured

randomness.folds: frozen registry (released as FigS10_condition_folds.csv and FigS10_pair_halves.csv)
randomness.regime_rows: equal to regimes._historical_training_rows in all 7192 held-out cells and regimes
randomness.a: common.whole_array_interval: default_rng(20260920), 10,000 draws, a fresh generator per regime
randomness.b: structure.permutation_p: default_rng(20260920), 4,999 permutations, a fresh generator per array

transformation.a: Molecule-disjoint validation (regimes.py): the molecules of each role are split into groups (five partitions, groups in FigS10_molecule_groups.csv); for each pair of a partner-1 group and a partner-2 group, the pairs combining them are held out and the training pairs are, by regime: all other pairs (both molecules measured in other pairs; a target is scored only if both occur in training); all pairs without a held partner-1 molecule (partner 1 new); the mirror image (partner 2 new); all pairs without a held molecule in either role (both new). The recommender, fitted on the training pairs only: the out-of-fold, cross-fitted preference (condition folds in FigS10_condition_folds.csv) predicted by an equal blend of a ten-neighbour ECFP4 Tanimoto model and a rank-8 bilinear ridge model on truncated-SVD fingerprints (random_state 0) and ten standardized descriptors; its trio = the three largest of training condition mean + prediction. Gain = best measured yield of that trio minus that of the complementary trio of the training pairs (greedy); scored when every condition of the panels is measured. Interval: 10,000 whole-array draws, default_rng(20260920), arrays in sorted identifier order; pooled mean = sum / count over the scored cases.
transformation.b: Arrays first require at least 40 pairs of two named molecules and 200 comparable pair-pairs (at least eight common conditions); pairs with constant raw yield profiles are then removed. Profile: the out-of-fold slope residual with a condition mean removed that is estimated on the other half of the pairs (halves in FigS10_pair_halves.csv; condition folds as in panel a); agreement = Pearson r of two pairs' profiles over common conditions; similarity = mean of the two partners' ECFP4 Tanimoto (radius 2, 2,048 bits). rho = Spearman correlation of similarity and agreement over all comparable pair-pairs; p = (hits + 1) / 5,000 over 4,999 permutations of whole structure labels (default_rng(20260920), a fresh generator per array), the eligibility held fixed; q = Benjamini-Hochberg over the 14 arrays.

a.label: Both molecules measured in other pairs
